notes: This book is by Eve Bunting (not unknown). The story features Mr. and Mrs. Moose wanting to have a turkey for Thanksgiving — but as a guest, not as dinner. The turkey runs and hides before being persuaded to join the feast as a friend. Key vocabulary should reflect the holiday setting, the characters (moose family, turkey), and the themes of invitation and thankfulness. The hero symbol must depict a live turkey bird; avoid any image of a cooked or plated turkey. 'Feast' and 'thankful' are thematically central and worth including despite being slightly abstract, as they are core Thanksgiving concepts students will encounter repeatedly.
